content_fields.title: Implement package registry security (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Secure the package registry this project publishes to or consumes from.
content_fields.guidance: Registry access should require authentication, publishing should be limited to the release pipeline, packages should be immutable once published, and upstream proxying should be restricted to reviewed sources.
content_fields.found: Dependencies are resolved from the public index with no private registry, and the project publishes nothing.
content_fields.missing: A private registry and its access configuration.
content_fields.conclusion: Registry security settings live in the registry service rather than in this repository.
content_fields.action: The platform team should configure the package registry controls if a private registry is adopted.
